claims.claim: ELNET France is a declared professional interest-representation organization with stable six-figure annual lobbying expenditure and explicit policy objectives.
ELNET-funded or organized parliamentary trips create repeated access/exposure to Israeli political, diplomatic, military and civil-society actors.
claims.gap: Access does not identify changed vote or decision.

claims.claim: ELNET deliberately seeks to shape parliamentary agendas and public decisions.
claims.gap: Intent does not establish success or control.

claims.claim: A specific ELNET proposal or trip caused an adopted French law, amendment, vote or foreign-policy decision.
claims.gap: No versioned contribution-to-text trace or counterfactual isolates marginal effect.

claims.claim: ELNET France is generally tasked or controlled by the Israeli state.
claims.gap: Own-account declaration and no authenticated general tasking record; prior INV-026 had only specific ELNET Europe transaction funding.

claims.claim: ELNET access amounts to reliable control of French policy.
claims.gap: The 2025 Palestine-recognition objective failed at final policy outcome.

claims.claim: US Friends of ELNET funding directly financed ELNET France in the inspected period.
claims.gap: No direct transfer record to French entity obtained.

controls.control: Funding/trip/access is not influence, tasking or capture without downstream evidence.
First-party inspiration/commitment claims are intent/self-report, not independent effect evidence.
Existing-proposal chronology blocks reverse attribution for Maillard 2019.
Own-account declaration and prior specific funding cannot establish general state tasking.
Palestine recognition is negative control against reliable policy control, not proof of zero influence.
Inquiry proposal is allegation/procedure, not factual finding.

facts.subject: registered representative
facts.value: HATVP identifies ELNET France as an association intervening at local and national levels in international cooperation and public institutions.

facts.subject: named representatives
facts.value: HATVP lists Ariel Bellaiche, Charlotte Gribe and Arie Bensemhoun as persons responsible for interest representation.

facts.subject: spending band
facts.value: HATVP shows declared representation spending at at least EUR100,000 and below EUR200,000 for each year 2021 through 2025.

facts.subject: representation staffing
facts.value: HATVP records three persons devoted to interest representation and notes spending includes salaries and events with public decision-makers.

facts.subject: own-account representation
facts.value: HATVP activity sheets state ELNET France performed declared representation activities for its own account.

facts.subject: anti-recognition objective
facts.value: A 2025 HATVP activity objective is to oppose recognition of the State of Palestine by France, targeting presidential, parliamentary and foreign-affairs actors.

facts.subject: declared influence techniques
facts.value: HATVP records actions including transmitting suggestions to influence drafting of public decisions, correspondence, debates and events.

facts.subject: historical policy objectives
facts.value: Historical HATVP sheets include strengthening parliamentary/legal action against anti-Jewish hatred and inspiring French political actors on vaccination policy.

facts.subject: Maillard trip
facts.value: Assembly travel disclosure records Sylvain Maillard in Israel 6-9 October 2024 with ELNET as third-party funder.

facts.subject: Berge trip
facts.value: Assembly travel disclosure records Aurore Berge in Israel 6-8 October 2024 invited by ELNET.

facts.subject: multiple MPs 2021 trip
facts.value: Assembly disclosures identify David Corceiro, Belkhir Belhaddad and Jean-Michel Mis among MPs travelling to Israel with ELNET as organizer/funder.

facts.subject: 38 elected officials mission
facts.value: François Pupponi declared an ELNET France mission involving 38 elected officials and meetings with high Israeli authorities.

facts.subject: strategic framing
facts.value: The 2021 disclosure frames the mission as promoting France-Israel strategic relations and covering security, Covid, Abraham Accords and regional conflict.

facts.subject: inspire parliamentary action
facts.value: ELNET France stated the March 2023 delegation was designed around themes apt to inspire MPs parliamentary action on return to France.

facts.subject: 15 LR MPs high-level access
facts.value: ELNET reports organizing a 15-LR-MP delegation with meetings involving Israeli foreign-affairs, Knesset, military and civil-society actors.

facts.subject: caucus suggestion
facts.value: ELNET reports an Israeli Foreign Ministry official suggested creating a French parliamentary study group on the Abraham Accords and the delegation agreed to study modalities.

facts.subject: first-party downstream claims
facts.value: ELNET self-reports delegation commitments and lessons; these statements are first-party reporting, not independent causal measurement.

facts.subject: resolution chronology
facts.value: At an ELNET-organized 2019 meeting, Sylvain Maillard presented his existing resolution project; contact is proven, ELNET causation is not.

facts.subject: disciplinary request
facts.value: An ELNET France open letter asked the President of the National Assembly for disciplinary sanctions against MP Aymeric Caron; request does not prove outcome.

facts.subject: inquiry proposal not finding
facts.value: Assembly dossier confirms resolution proposal no.1000 seeking an inquiry was deposited and referred to the Laws Committee; this is allegation/procedure, not an established finding.

facts.subject: transparent influence boundary
facts.value: Senate work distinguishes transparent lawful influence from covert/deceptive interference; invitation/contact alone is insufficient for an interference finding.

facts.subject: Palestine recognition negative control
facts.value: President Macron declared that France recognized the State of Palestine, contrary to ELNET Frances declared 2025 objective to prevent recognition.

facts.subject: US support organization scale
facts.value: US Friends of ELNET filings show multimillion-dollar annual contributions/revenue; this does not establish a direct transfer to ELNET France.

facts.subject: repeated delegation model
facts.value: ELNETs delegation index documents repeated parliamentary/political delegations across years.

facts.subject: parliamentary forum access
facts.value: ELNET reports a France-Germany-Israel parliamentary forum in the National Assembly with MPs and experts.

facts.subject: senior target categories
facts.value: HATVP sheets identify target categories including presidential collaborators, MPs/senators, government/cabinet members and foreign-affairs officials.
